cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government digital-skills programme for the public is in service and has trained a stated number of people.
cells.note: The youth ministry signed an agreement in June 2026 for a national programme to train about 40,000 young people, piloting in five provinces. The only count, 50 youths, is from a pilot in Matola, so not stage 3.
